findings.what: The first company's name isn't visible once you scroll into the table, and the best-looking numbers are under it
Same tracks repeated over and over across 15 companies with no summary or recommendation. You get lost and want to quit
Exposure above 100% (101%, 103%) looks like a mistake or something risky
Two fees per track with no explanation of which one actually matters
Fees only as percentages, nothing in shekels, so 0.5% feels like nothing
A yellow banner saying the data isn't updated scares you off right at the start
Lots of 'פחות מ־3 שנים' and 'עוד לא דווח', with no way to compare those tracks
